map.输入目标斜切角、材料厚度与锯条类型，计算倒角宽度、刃口行程与锯条跑偏补偿，并给出: Enter the target bevel angle, material thickness and blade type to compute the chamfer width, blade travel and blade-drift compensation, plus a compound miter/bevel conversion table.
map.核心计算公式（按输入变量）：min(89.9,max(0,th))；th×π÷1: Core formulas (by input variables): min(89.9,max(0,th)); th×π÷180
map.家具倒角与斜边拼接：给板件做 45° 倒角或拼接斜边时，先算板面倒角宽与刃口行程: Furniture chamfer and beveled-edge joints: when chamfering a panel at 45° or joining a beveled edge, first compute the face chamfer width and blade travel to confirm the blade can cut through in one pass.
map.冠线/顶线贴角切割：墙面内角/外角转角处贴冠线，需用复合斜切（Miter+Bev: Crown molding / cove corner cuts: where crown meets an inside/outside wall corner, use the compound miter (Miter+Bevel) formula to convert the corner angle into the saw-table angle.
map.曲线锯斜切参数设定：曲线锯锯条在斜切时易跑偏，按锯条类型补偿底板角度，保证实际切: Curve-saw bevel setup: a curve-saw blade tends to drift when beveling; compensate the base-plate angle by blade type so the actual cut angle stays accurate.
map.斜切示例（45° / 板厚 20mm / 曲线锯 / 标准刃 / 冠角 45°）: Bevel example (45° / 20mm stock / curve saw / standard tooth / 45° crown)
map.板面倒角宽 = 20 × tan45° = 20.0 mm；刃口行程 = 20: Face chamfer width = 20 × tan45° = 20.0 mm; blade travel = 20 / cos45° = 28.28 mm; curve-saw drift = 0.04 × 1.0 × 28.28 × sin45° = 0.80 mm, suggest raising base-plate compensation angle atan(0.80/28.28) = 1.62°. Compound miter: for 90° corner and 45° crown, saw-table miter M = atan(sin45°/tan45°) = 35.26°, bevel B = asin(cos45°×sin45°) = 30.00°.
map.为什么曲线锯斜切会跑偏？: Why does a curve saw drift when beveling?
map.曲线锯条窄而柔，斜切时刃口受力不均、侧向分力使锯路偏移。模型取 K=0.04 乘: A curve-saw blade is narrow and flexible; when beveling, uneven tooth load and the lateral force shift the kerf. The model uses K=0.04 multiplied by the blade factor (heavy tooth 0.5 / standard 1.0 / thin tooth 1.8) then by blade travel and sinθ to estimate drift; circular and miter saws have rigid blades so it is negligible. Compensate by locking the orbital action off, feeding slowly against a guide rail, and raising the base-plate compensation angle.
map.复合斜切的冠角公式怎么用？: How do I use the crown-angle compound-miter formula?
map.贴冠线时已知墙角转角 C 与冠线自身冠角 S，锯台斜切角 M = atan(si: When fitting crown molding, given wall-corner angle C and the molding own crown angle S, saw-table miter M = atan(sinS / tan(C/2)) and bevel B = asin(cosS × sin(C/2)). Use C=90° for inside corners and C=270° (or the equivalent inside angle) for outside corners; set the computed M/B directly on the saw table to complete the corner joint.
map.木工斜切角度与刃口行程计算: Woodworking Bevel Angle & Kerf Travel Calculation
map.板面倒角宽度 = t × tanθ（t 材料厚度 mm）: Bevel width on the face = t × tanθ (t material thickness in mm)
map.刃口行程（切面长）= t ÷ cosθ: Kerf travel (cut face length) = t ÷ cosθ
map.锯条跑偏量 = K × 锯条系数 × 刃口行程 × sinθ（mm）: Blade wander = K × blade factor × kerf travel × sinθ (mm)
map.锯条系数：厚齿 0.5 / 标准 1.0 / 薄齿细齿 1.8: Blade factor: coarse tooth 0.5 / standard 1.0 / thin fine tooth 1.8
map.建议补偿角 = atan(跑偏量 ÷ 刃口行程)，实际设定角 = θ + 补偿角: Suggested compensation angle = atan(wander ÷ kerf travel), actual setting angle = θ + compensation angle
map.刃口行程超过锯类可用刃长 → 无法一次切透，需换长锯条或分次切削: When kerf travel exceeds the saw's usable blade length, the cut cannot be made in one pass; use a longer blade or cut in stages
map.θ > 45° 曲线锯极易跑偏，建议改圆锯 + 导轨；θ ≥ 80° 接近水平切: Above 45° a jigsaw wanders badly, so switch to a circular saw with a guide rail; at 80° or more the cut approaches horizontal and needs staged feeding
map.复合斜切换算表：由冠角 S 与墙角转角 C 反求锯台斜切角(Miter)与倒角角: Compound miter conversion table: back-calculate the miter and bevel angles from the crown spring angle S and the wall corner angle C
map.目标斜切角须在 0–89.9° 之间（0°=直切）；超出范围不计算，也不静默截断: Target bevel angle must be between 0 and 89.9° (0° = straight cut); out-of-range values are rejected, not silently clamped. At 90° or above there is no bevel face to cut.
map.材料厚度必须是有限正数（> 0 mm）。: Material thickness must be a finite positive value (> 0 mm).
map.冠角/弹簧角须在 0–90° 之间；该值只用于复合斜切换算表，超出范围三角函数组: Crown/spring angle must be between 0 and 90°; it only drives the compound-miter table, and out-of-range values have no corresponding installed position.
map.锯条跑偏量（经验初估）= K × 锯条系数 × 刃口行程 × sinθ（mm）；: Blade drift (empirical estimate) = K × blade factor × blade travel × sinθ (mm); if a test-cut drift is entered, the measured value takes priority
map.K：曲线锯 0.04，圆锯/斜切锯按 0（模型未计入，不代表无跑偏）: K: jigsaw 0.04; circular/miter saw 0 (not modelled, which does not mean zero drift)
map.刃口行程超过可用切深 → 无法一次切透；可用切深可填实测值，留空用参考值（曲线锯: Blade travel greater than available depth → cannot cut through in one pass; enter a measured depth or leave blank for reference (jigsaw 60 / circular 80 / miter 110 mm)
map.实测可用切深/刃长（mm，可选）: Measured available depth / blade length (mm, optional)
map.倒角与斜边：按目标斜切角、板厚算板面倒角宽与刃口行程，先判断能否一次切透。: Chamfer and bevel: from target bevel angle and board thickness, compute face chamfer width and blade travel, and check whether one pass can cut through.
map.设备能力核对：可填实测可用切深与试切跑偏量，优先用实测值；留空才用参考/经验模型: Machine capability: enter measured available depth and test-cut drift when available; otherwise use reference/empirical models.
map.复合斜切换算：把冠角与墙角转角换算成锯台斜切角与倒角角，作为试切起点。: Compound miter: convert crown angle and wall corner into miter and bevel angles as a starting point for a test cut.
map.板面倒角宽 = 18×tan30° = 10.39 mm；刃口行程 = 18/c: Face chamfer = 18×tan30° = 10.39 mm; blade travel = 18/cos30° = 20.78 mm; empirical drift = 0.04×1.0×20.78×sin30° ≈ 0.42 mm, compensation ≈ atan(0.42/20.78) = 1.15°. If measured depth 100 mm and test-cut drift 1 mm are entered, measured values are used; if travel exceeds measured depth, the page says one pass cannot cut through. Circular/miter saws do not use the jigsaw drift model and show “not modelled”.
map.补偿角能直接输进机器吗？: Can the compensation angle be entered into the machine directly?
map.不能。补偿只是试切前的参考调整，不是设备设定指令；实际偏差随锯条、材料、进给与设: No. Compensation is a reference adjustment before a test cut, not a machine setting. Actual drift varies with blade, material, feed and machine condition; confirm with the manual and a test cut.
map.为什么圆锯不显示跑偏量？: Why does a circular saw show no drift?
map.圆锯与斜切锯锯片刚性好，曲线锯的窄条跑偏模型不适用。页面显示“模型未计入”，不表: Circular and miter saw blades are stiff, so the narrow jigsaw drift model does not apply. “Not modelled” does not mean there is no drift.
